title: competitor.compared
description: A competitor comparison finished. Carries where the site stands and the subjects it does not cover; the profiles and the full theme list stay behind the result url.

compared_against.description: How many competitors had a large enough sample to be judged against. Lower than the number asked for whenever a crawl was too small or could not be fetched.

behind_on.description: Metric names where the site sits below the competitors' median by more than the margin.

top_missing_themes.description: Terms at least two competitors write about and this site does not.
